High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 seeking anticipatory bail in connection with Crime No.249/2018 registered at Police Station Sohagpur, District Shahdol, for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471,
120-B and 34 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. Learned Senior Advocate appearing on behalf of the applicant has submitted that the prosecution case, in nutshell, is that the applicant's father was a registered owner of the vehicle/bus bearing registration No.MP-18- 6155 which was to complete 15 years, hence, he changed the engine number and chassis number of the said vehicle and got it registered in Jharkhand as JH-01-P-4872 and after that, it was transferred in the name of the applicant's NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:43140 2 MCRC-38906-2025 father.
The vehicle was endorsed by the RTO Shahdol and was being plied on the road without paying the permit fee.

It is alleged that the after the death of applicant's father, in the family partition, the said vehicle came into share and possession of the applicant and thus, it is clear that basically the original crime was not committed by the present applicant.
It is contended that the applicant is suffering from cancer and getting the treatment at Tata Memorial Center, Mumbai.
According to him, in these circumstances, no fruitful purpose would be served by keeping the applicant behind the bars, hence, he be granted the benefit of anticipatory bail.

3. sentences.text:
4. Heard the parties and perused the case diary.
5.

Considering the facts and circumstances brought on record coupled with the facts that the case pertains to the year 2018 and till date, the applicant has not been arrested, this Court is inclined to allow this application.
Thus, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that in the event of arrest the applicant - Pushpendra Mishra shall be enlarged on bail on his furnishing a personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for his appearance before it during the course of investigation or before the trial Court concerned during trial, as the case may be.
NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:43140 3 MCRC-38906-2025 7.
The applicant is directed to cooperate with the Investigating Agency and shall also appear on the date and time as directed by the Investigating Officer.

8 . It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by all the conditions as enumerated under Section 482(2) of BNSS.
9.
Accordingly, the application stands disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.
